svg.title: Lines added by each pass of the same prompt
svg.desc: Woodhouse issue #98. Two sequential passes of one prompt per task, one task per isolated worktree, default agent session model, no other work on the worktree between passes. Multi-requirement task: pass 1 added 313 lines, pass 2 added 56 and replaced 15. Single-requirement task: pass 1 added 66, pass 2 added nothing. Pass 2 of the multi-requirement task also found a counting defect affecting 8 of 19 dispatches, by up to 14 words each.
